description: Kwijtschelding with the switch on: the forgiven DUO balance is positive vermogensaanwas in the year it lapses (switch off: tax-free)
source: Hand calculation from the bill text: Wet werkelijk rendement box 3, Kamerstukken 36 748 nr. 2 (https://zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl/kst-36748-2.html: art. 2.13, 5.1, 5.2, 5.40, 5.65, 5.67, VI) as amended by novelle 37 053 nr. 2 (https://www.tweedekamer.nl/downloads/document?id=2026D55225: art. 5.26, 5.32). No official calculator exists (#16). Kwijtschelding as positive vermogensaanwas: MvT 36 748 §3.10 and art. 5.8(2)(a), as found in #15 (docs/research/box3-kwijtschelding.md on research/box3-kwijtschelding).
derivation: The term ends in 2029 with 20.000 DUO debt left, forgiven by law (Wsf art. 6.16). With nominal valuation the debt falls from 20.000 to 0 without payment: +20.000 vermogensaanwas (#15). DUO interest charged in the year 540 (2,70% × 20.000) is negative income. Resultaat 20.000 − 540 = 19.460; heffingsvrij resultaat 1.800 → inkomen 17.660; tax 36% × 17.660 = 6.357,60 → 6.357, about 36% of (forgiven balance − DUO interest − heffingsvrij resultaat) as #15 estimated. With the switch off the kwijtschelding is ignored: resultaat −540 → a 540 verlies, tax 0.
